import java.util.Scanner;
import java.io.PrintWriter;

public class Main {
    private static final long MOD = 1000000007L;

    private static long fastPow(long a, long p) {
        long res = 1;
        long powPart = a % MOD;
        long mask = 1;
        int bits = 64; // long has 64 bits
        for (int i = 0; i < bits; i++) {
            if ((p & mask) != 0) {
                res = (res * powPart) % MOD;
            }
            mask <<= 1;
            powPart = (powPart * powPart) % MOD;
        }
        return res;
    }

    private static boolean solve(Scanner scanner, PrintWriter writer, boolean multipleTestMode) {
        if (!scanner.hasNextLong()) {
            return false;
        }
        long p = scanner.nextLong();
        if (!scanner.hasNextLong()) {
            return false;
        }
        long k = scanner.nextLong();

        if (multipleTestMode && !scanner.hasNext()) {
            return false;
        }

        // LOCAL_PRINT equivalent omitted

        if (k == 0) {
            long ans = fastPow(p, p - 1);
            writer.println(ans);
            return multipleTestMode;
        }

        if (k == 1) {
            long ans = fastPow(p, p);
            writer.println(ans);
            return multipleTestMode;
        }

        boolean[] used = new boolean[(int)(p + 1)];
        long ans = 1;
        long groups = 0;

        for (long x = 1; x < p; x++) {
            if (used[(int)x]) continue;

            groups++;
            ans = (ans * p) % MOD;

            used[(int)x] = true;
            long v = x;
            do {
                v = (v * k) % p;
                if (used[(int)v]) break;
                used[(int)v] = true;
            } while (true);
        }

        writer.println(ans);
        return multipleTestMode;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner scanner = new Scanner(System.in);
        PrintWriter writer = new PrintWriter(System.out, true);

        // Simulate the behavior: if ONLINE_JUDGE is defined, run once; else loop.
        // Since we don't have a preprocessor, we'll always loop (which works for both cases).
        while (solve(scanner, writer, true)) {
            // continue
        }

        scanner.close();
        writer.close();
    }
}
